correctness.rationale: The exact substitution s=x+y-1, d=y-x, rescaled time tau=alpha*t/2 yields f=s(1-s^2-3d^2), g=d(1-2k-3s^2-d^2), k=beta/alpha. Direct algebra reproduces the original two mean-field ODEs and their Jacobian; symmetric d=sqrt(1-2k) has physical eigenvalues 3beta-alpha, 2beta-alpha. Off-center fixed points satisfy s^2=(1-3k)/4,d^2=(1+k)/4 with determinant 2(1+k)(3k-1)<0. At k=1/3, center manifold d=1/sqrt3-(3sqrt3/2)s^2+..., s-prime=8s^3+..., so branch is nonlinearly repelling. Stable strictly interacting ordered branch iff epsilon>1/sqrt3, alpha>3beta and 1-2beta/alpha<epsilon^2. Independent symbolic check succeeded; excluded d=epsilon switching surface and population asymmetry do not follow.
